commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Venezia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+2' Kike Perez (Venezia) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+2' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

90+1' Good chance! John Yeboah (Venezia) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

87' Here is a change. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Cheick Conde (Venezia).
86' The referee is firm and issues Ionut Radu (Venezia) a deserved yellow card.
85' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ionut Radu intercepts the ball.
83' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
83' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) steps up to send the ball in.
81' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alfred Duncan (Venezia) replacing Mirko Maric.

78' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ionut Radu intercepts the ball.

73' We are about to witness a substitution. Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is replacing Mateo Retegui.
73' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Stefan Posch is replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).

73' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
71' The corner kick from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
71' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atalanta.
68' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 12:6.
65' The Atalanta players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
64' John Yeboah (Venezia) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Marco Carnesecchi is alert and denies him.
62' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Issa Doumbia (Venezia) for Gianluca Busio.
60' It's time for a substitution. John Yeboah (Venezia) comes on in place of Gaetano Oristanio.
60' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Charles De Ketelaere and he is replaced by Daniel Maldini (Atalanta).
59' A substitution has been made. Juan Cuadrado goes off and Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) comes on.
59' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
56' Dangerous play by Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia). Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Mirko Maric (Venezia) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.

52' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Ionut Radu guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

51' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
48' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) commits a rough foul. Giuseppe Collu stops the game and makes a call.

47' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

44' Ionut Radu pulls off a great save to deny Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
42' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul.

40' OFF THE POST! Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.

38' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Ionut Radu makes a great save to stop his effort.
37' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
36' A pass from Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) is intercepted by Ionut Radu and the move breaks down. The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.
34' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ionut Radu, who smothers the ball.
34' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
33' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Venezia was in an offside position.
32' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
30' Giuseppe Collu couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Gianluca Busio (Venezia) and blew his whistle.
29' Atalanta enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
27' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
25' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
25' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
24' Fali Cande (Venezia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Giuseppe Collu no option but to blow his whistle. Atalanta have a free kick.
23' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

22' Ademola Lookman pings in a cross towards the edge of the six-yard box. Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) jumps highest but sends his header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
21' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is flagged for offside.
20' Chance! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
19' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) is caught offside!
18' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Handball! A player from Venezia handled the ball.
15' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
14' Great teamplay by Atalanta as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
12' 0:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
9' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
8' PENALTY APPEAL after Kike Perez (Venezia) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Venezia.
6' Good clearance! Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Venezia earn a corner.
5' The Atalanta players are exchanging some short passes.
4' A pass from Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi and the move breaks down.
2' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
2' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
2' Rough tackle by Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
